purpose: R2/R3 protocol with isolated H/HA localization-training source implemented; no GPU qualification or formal R2 training yet.
research_goal: Integrate A/B/C and achieve at least+2 percentage points in all seven standard metrics using one selected checkpoint/configuration across the three benchmarks.

main_claims.claim: Compressed competitive history and soft multifuture information improve dense candidate generation and localization.
main_claims.minimum_evidence: Compare against equally trained fusion/head control, equal-capacity prompt memories and equal visual/candidate budgets; full tracking metrics plus actual dense/TopK recall and selected localization quality.

main_claims.claim: Actual-consequence search and graded state submission retain useful recovery while reducing harmful interventions.
main_claims.minimum_evidence: Matched current-state action consequences, full-video harm/recovery/write diagnostics and comparisons to keep/box-only/fixed-pause/geometry-copy controls.

anti_claims: Gain only comes from retraining fusion/head.
Gain only comes from more memory or extra visual forwards.
Cache quality improves while continuous tracking degrades.

data.full979_retraining: Only after architecture/hyperparameters lock and explicit disclosure of baseline original training scope; not silently substituted for881.
data.baseline_original_pretraining_dev_exposu: Unattested; do not call DEV untouched.
data.existing_r1_cache: Reuse as provenance/event-time guides only. Once feature/head/policy changes, old candidate/action labels do not become deployment-consistent automatically.

shared_training.batch_size: Locked after one finite32/64 feasibility/throughput probe, before formal fitting; same chosen batch in both variants.
shared_training.visual_backbone: ViT frozen/eval; extraction no_grad separated from differentiable fusion/head.
shared_training.trainable: Original fusion convolution and Center head in both variants; A projection/readout additionally in A variant.
shared_training.initialization_policy: Only clip-first annotation initializes state. Later GT is for loss/labels, not search centers or accepted history.
shared_training.inference_precision: Preserve float32 baseline comparison; any training autocast is measured and disclosed before locking.
shared_training.data_order_implementation: Pass an independently seeded torch.Generator to the training DataLoader/sampler. Record actual sequence, clip-start and query-index order hashes for both matched variants, independently of module initialization.
shared_training.fusion_head_BN_mode: Train including original BatchNorm, identical H/HA; not asserted equal to original paper trainer.

variants.system: Pure CAD+trained fusion/head, no A/B/C new mechanism
Same trainable fusion/head+pre-fusion competitive memory prompt A

A.insertion: Separate RGB/TIR ViT output maps before the existing fusion convolution.
A.budget: Preserve four slots per sensor: two target, one non-target, one uncertain; immutable first-frame anchors.
A.read: Target support, competing evidence and unknown context remain separate; unknown or merely unselected candidates are not automatically negatives.
A.initialization: Zero residual output projection for baseline-aligned epoch0.
A.compression_supervision: Preserve target/hard-candidate score differences from causal past evidence, with actual training-GT quality/ranking supervision.
A.first_pair_scope: Tests prompt insertion against identical head training; does not itself prove persistent rejected tracklets or complete A/B/C effectiveness.

r2_first_pair.checkpoint_selection: Finish prescribed20 epochs; use complete98-video sequence-equal mean IoU for overall best and separately best positive epoch. Cached/short-clip values only monitor. If overall best is epoch0, retain and label it as initialization, and still formally test the preselected best positive epoch.
r2_first_pair.official_testing: One preselected checkpoint/config per reported trained run across all three complete datasets, including negative results. An unchanged pure epoch0 uses the user-provided LasHeR reference and existing pure RGB reports, without rerunning forbidden pure LasHeR. A positive-epoch result is never replaced by parent scores.
r2_first_pair.parameter_count: Measured from the implemented warm model; not inferred from the old414164 ABC parameters.
r2_first_pair.selection_semantics_source: cadtrack_abc/select_future_actions.py:45-79 separates selected and trained_selected; new dense runner must retain these reporting semantics without loading the future-action model family.

M0.prerequisite: Current R1 matched formal chain terminal, original controller exit verified; new isolated implementation and source review completed.
checks: Read actual /home output free disk space and compare measured checkpoint/log budget; datasets stay read-only under/data.
Verify original pretrained SHA/strict loading, split identities and sampled file/clip order.
Verify float32 epoch0 outputs/crops/Hann/update decisions against original pure path; zero prompt residual gives identical behavior.
Real finite forward/backward: localization/fusion and enabled A have finite nonzero gradients and parameter changes; frozen ViT tensors remain exact; changed checkpoint strictly reloads.
Use the actual Center head normalized cxcywh convention and separate supervised regression indexing from prediction-driven tracking state.
Measure batch32/64 training clips/sec, peak allocation and wall time; choose the same feasible batch for both formal runs. No assumption that inference concurrency measurements apply to training.

In the actual new video-data runner, verify the two variants consume the same sequence/clip-start/query order hash using a separate data RNG. The completed CPU DataLoader witness is a precondition demonstration, not integrated R2 qualification.
M0.source_scope: Frozen ViT extraction; differentiable original fusion/Center head; optional pre-fusion competitive memory A; H/HA only, B/C still pending.
M0.first_attempt_import_failure: Native lib.utils package __init__ imports tensor.py, omitted from the previous vendor subset; exact native copy added.

experiment_blocks.target: Dense localization improvement beyond ordinary head training.
experiment_blocks.success: A improves full98 continuous tracking and candidate/localization diagnostics under matched training; final seven-metric target remains explicit.
experiment_blocks.negative_interpretation: If ordinary head training explains the gain, do not attribute it to A.

experiment_blocks.target: B improves actual candidate coverage and localization rather than only motion NLL.
experiment_blocks.constraints: Retain visual path,3 modes/3 steps initially, at most one extra visual region; no unseen-region information.

experiment_blocks.target: C improves realized action consequences and limits future harm.
experiment_blocks.constraints: Collect current trained policy states/actions; do not reuse old geometry/feature-dependent labels as if unchanged. RGB-only/TIR-only denote submission actions, not deleting a sensor observation.

experiment_blocks.target: Full method+2 in seven metrics and actual component effects.
experiment_blocks.constraints: Equal training, memory, candidates and visual budget where relevant; same checkpoint per row; full attrs/curves/per-sequence results, inference cost and paired intervals where raw baseline exists.

compute.training_concurrency: One formal fit per card, two matched variants in parallel after M0.
compute.inference_concurrency: At most two per card; old1.573856578 throughput is prior inference evidence, not a promised scaling result for the new method.
compute.estimated_gpu_hours: After M0: sum over variants[400000/measured_clips_per_second/3600]+full98 selection+three-benchmark inference. No unmeasured fixed-hour promise.

milestones.gate: Same-control-checkpoint all3 full reports/real exits; do not infer completion from elapsed time.
